goal: Correct an overly broad origin restriction that removed an owner-authorized primary-teacher curriculum artifact.
procedure: When the project owner explicitly represents that a teacher/source is authorized for the intended model-development use, record the authorization scope and actor, integrity-bind the artifact, preserve normal quality/provenance checks, and allow the material into the training workflow. Do not substitute a generic provider assumption for an explicit owner authorization record.
constraints: do not claim independent verification beyond owner representation
private identity data remains outside public Git
teacher authorization does not itself authorize private identity gradients
identity truth still comes from governed source evidence rather than generic teacher preference
authority: Owner authorization governs whether this teaching source may be used in the project. This trace does not grant historical identity authority or first-private-gradient authority.
validation: Restored the original 60-row Sol N0 seed by its original Git blob hash, changed validation to require explicit owner authorization for service-teacher origin, retained integrity checking, and wired the seed into the N0 train-curriculum stage.
failure_or_lesson: Do not discard high-value construction supervision because of a generic assumption when the owner has explicitly represented that the project has permission. Preserve the authorization as provenance and continue building.
notes: This records the reusable correction. It does not contain private Elaina payloads or confidential agreement text.
